title: Thank you for the feedback. I have made some changes...
author: RISOvonVODKA
selftext:
Hey! So here is a little gameplay from my phone. I have made some changes to how I built my assets and maps. Now, mostly by hand with custom 2D/3D aplication that allows me to draw, place assets,  rotate or change parts of the map with generative AI, and then adjust it by hand. 

Here is the first mission with a bit of a story. Dusk has an ability yo corrupt the ground she takes. There are tendrils growing from her buildings and vines connecting them. The ground also changes appearance to show the corruption. 

After retaking the building, the light will heal the ground, but it takes longer (just like in real life).

comments.author: Shalke97
comments.body:
The style is not "bad" its just too high detailed in my opinion. There are too many details cramped in too little space and thats just a normal ChatGPT sickness if you dont prompt it otherwise. Well, i would probably throw a screenshot of some of your models into chatgpt and play around with various different styles. Especially if you're trying to get on the mobile market. 

The approach you're doing with basically layering images on top of eachother is really shaky in my opinion. I mean its a good solution for what it is! But it just looks a little rough because you can clearly see that there is no depth to the map and that you're basically moving your characters over a 2D Image. I don't think its visually appealing. 

I can clearly see that you've already put a tremendous amount of time into that system and i know, that restarting is not an option. But i would tweak the style a little, chat with ChatGPT about it, let him make you recommendations. Thats what he spat out for me. Of course it has to fit your vision this is just an example. 

Also a good advice: Sometimes, if you work too long on something artistic, you tend to lose focus of its flaws. That happend to me on my games UI and when i showed it proudly to some friends, they all spoke negatively about it and in hindsight they were completetly right. So i'd recommend that you always get more opinions in! 

https://i.redd.it/ueymxvmkqeyh1.png

replies.author: RISOvonVODKA
replies.body:
Thank you for the feedback. 

System is built, the gameplay is actually great and I am really proud of it. The style and unique approach can always be rebuilt, I would rather do that now then not have people play it. 

The story is personal to me and it is about darkness consuimg the light within us. I will try and brainstrom how to make it a uniqe world with less detail, but more story.   
I will be back. Thanks!

replies.author: Shalke97
replies.body: No worries and do as you want! Feedback is fine but if it clashes with your expectations, don't force yourself to do it. There are ways to make those asset lol non-ai generated with some work, that would instantly convey more "quality". Right now peoiple will probably argue, that it was prompted really quickly because the asset doesn't seem to have gotten much revision.
